CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible BIBLE? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible BIBLE to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible BIBLE.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Bible BIBLE has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS? (1 mark)
   A. Use Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Communicating to? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Communicating to.
   B. Apply the teaching of Communicating to with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Communicating to to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Communicating to has no place in daily life.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

6. Which response best shows understanding of Love of God and? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love of God and.
   B. Say Love of God and has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Love of God and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Love of God and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND? (1 mark)
   A. Use Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND.
   D. Apply the teaching of Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of Church as a place? (1 mark)
   A. Say Church as a place has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Church as a place.
   C. Apply the teaching of Church as a place with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Church as a place to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Birth of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Birth of Jesus has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Jesus.
   D. Use Birth of Jesus to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of My family CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Use My family CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say My family CREATION has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My family CREATION.
   D. Apply the teaching of My family CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Who is CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Who is CREATION.
   B. Say Who is CREATION has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Who is CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Who is CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Who is CREATION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain My family CREATION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
